'''Dwi'kar''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] and the third [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]], located within the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="guide" />

Along with the other gas giant of the system, [[Dwi'lar]], the two were known as "siblings" or "the twins" by the locals of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] that orbited between them. Dwi'kar was the hotter of the two and its surface consisted of orange and red gases.<ref name="guide" />

[[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] harvested [[blaster/Legends|blaster]] gases from the two planets and maintained an [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation orbiting station|orbital refinery]] on [[Dwi'kar's fifth moon]].<ref name="guide" />
